lines.text: Where's your glow from? Most light on your face goes inside you.
lines.phonemes: wˌeəz jɔː ɡlˈəʊ fɹɒm? mˈəʊst lˈaɪt ˌɒn jɔː fˈeɪs ɡəʊz ɪnsˈaɪd juː.

lines.text: Only about one ray in twenty bounces off as a glint. Smooth, hydrated skin sends it back one way; dry skin scatters it into a haze.
lines.phonemes: ˈəʊnli ɐbˌaʊt wˈɒn ɹˈeɪ ɪn twˈɛnti bˈaʊnsɪz ˈɒf az ɐ ɡlˈɪnt. smˈuːð, haɪdɹˈeɪtɪd skˈɪn sˈɛndz ɪt bˈak wˈɒn wˈeɪ; dɹˈaɪ skˈɪn skˈatəz ɪt ˌɪntʊ ɐ hˈeɪz.

lines.text: But the glint isn't the glow. The rest slips in, bounces among cells and fibres, and several times more finds its way back out.
lines.phonemes: bˌʌt ðə ɡlˈɪnt ˌɪzənt ðə ɡlˈəʊ. ðə ɹˈɛst slˈɪps ˈɪn, bˈaʊnsɪz ɐmˌʌŋ sˈɛlz and fˈaɪbəz, and sˈɛvɹəl tˈaɪmz mˈɔː fˈaɪndz ɪts wˈeɪ bˈak ˈaʊt.

lines.text: You'd picture a glow as shine sitting on the skin. But it's light that has travelled through you, past your melanin and your blood.
lines.phonemes: juːd pˈɪktʃəɹ ɐ ɡlˈəʊ az ʃˈaɪn sˈɪtɪŋ ɒnðə skˈɪn. bˌʌt ɪts lˈaɪt ðat hɐz tɹˈavəld θɹˈuː juː, pˈast jɔː mˈɛlənɪn and jɔː blˈʌd.

lines.text: Blood moves with your heart, so your face changes colour with every beat: too faint to see, but an ordinary camera can count your pulse in it.
lines.phonemes: blˈʌd mˈuːvz wɪð jɔː hˈɑːt, sˌəʊ jɔː fˈeɪs tʃˈeɪndʒɪz kˈʌlə wɪð ˈɛvɹɪ bˈiːt: tˈuː fˈeɪnt tə sˈiː, bˌʌt ɐn ˈɔːdɪnəɹi kˈamɹə kan kˈaʊnt jɔː pˈʌls ɪn ɪt.

lines.text: And it goes deep: blue light barely a millimetre, about ten sheets of paper; red several times further, through the skin.
lines.phonemes: and ɪt ɡəʊz dˈiːp: blˈuː lˈaɪt bˈeəli ɐ mˈɪlɪmˌiːtə, ɐbˌaʊt tˈɛn ʃˈiːts ɒv pˈeɪpə; ɹˈɛd sˈɛvɹəl tˈaɪmz fˈɜːðə, θɹuː ðə skˈɪn.

lines.text: Film faces made by computer once looked like plastic: their light never went inside. Yours does; that's your glow.
lines.phonemes: fˈɪlm fˈeɪsɪz mˌeɪd baɪ kəmpjˈuːtə wˈʌns lˈʊkt lˈaɪk plˈastɪk: ðeə lˈaɪt nˈɛvə wɛnt ɪnsˈaɪd. jˈɔːz dˈʌz; ðats jɔː ɡlˈəʊ.

lines.text: Next: before birth, a cut healed without a trace. So why do you scar?
lines.phonemes: nˈɛkst: bɪfˌɔː bˈɜːθ, ɐ kˈʌt hˈiːld wɪðˌaʊt ɐ tɹˈeɪs. sˌəʊ wˌaɪ dˈuː juː skˈɑː?
